questions.ask: What name should I use for you: the one your writing goes out under?
What is the business or brand called?
Which platform do you post on most?
In one sentence: what do you help people with, and who are they?
Transcribe with ElevenLabs (recommended: most accurate, about $0.22 per hour of audio) or on this computer (free)?
Which kinds of writing do you want from each video by default?
Paste or upload 2-3 emails or posts you wrote yourself and are proud of, so the writing sounds like you on the page.
questions.default: none yet: voice taken from how they speak in each video

questions.ask: What offers, lead magnets or links may a call to action point to? For each: its name, the link, and when it fits.
When none of those fits a piece, what should the call to action be?
How do you sign off your emails?
questions.default: the creator's first name on its own line

questions.ask: Do you have a name for your list or your audience?
questions.default: no name: write to one reader as "you"

questions.ask: Which names, brands and terms should the transcript always spell correctly? (your name and brand are added automatically)
Are there words or phrases you never want in your copy?
Where should the folders of finished writing go?
